tier_1_direct.label: Tier 1 — Direct
tier_1_direct.definition: The combination was tested empirically in the same study: drug and modifier were applied together and death/viability was measured.

tier_2_inferred.label: Tier 2 — Inferred
tier_2_inferred.definition: Drug response and modifier response were measured separately, then joined via a shared cell line and a biologically plausible shared mechanism. No combined-treatment readout exists.

tier_2b_model_predicted.label: Tier 2b — Model-predicted
tier_2b_model_predicted.definition: Generated by the learned prediction layer (Step 2) for an untested drug x modifier x cell-line combination — distinct from Tier 2, which is a manual join of separate single-factor studies. Every Tier 2b row stores the model version / training-run ID it came from so predictions can be invalidated and regenerated as data and models improve. Experimental: low-confidence until validated against a critical mass of Tier 1 labels.

tier_3_mechanism_only.label: Tier 3 — Mechanism-only
tier_3_mechanism_only.definition: Signature overlap suggests a plausible interaction, but no death/viability readout exists for either factor in combination.
